# x402 String Similarity

> Deterministic string similarity metrics for agents. Levenshtein ratio, Jaccard, Dice coefficient. No accounts. Pay per call with x402 (USDC on Base).

## Paid Endpoint

- POST /api/score
  - Input: `{ "a": "...", "b": "...", "metric": "levenshtein|jaccard|dice|all" }`
  - Output: `{ "success": true, "result": number|object, "meta": {...} }`
  - Price: ~0.008 USDC

## Free Discovery

- GET /catalog
- GET / (service card)

## Why agents use it

- Zero variance, pure algorithms
- Token-cheap fuzzy matching for routing, dedup, ranking
- Perfect for agent memory, tool selection, content clustering
